general.languageExplain: Display language (menus, settings): French or English from your choice. Other codes show the UI in English for now. Mother language also drives dictation, translations, and AI output.
general.globalAddressBookExplain:
On: one address book for all accounts. Duplicate emails appear once.

Off: only contacts for the selected account.
general.activitySuggestionsExplain: Records activity on this device only to suggest saved views. Off = no collection.
general.archiveExplain: Hierarchical: Archive/YYYY/MM-month (app locale). Flat: server folder (Gmail All Mail, Archive…).
general.startupExplain: Default account at launch. “First account” = first in Settings → Accounts.
general.inboxExplain: Default filter when opening an IMAP folder.

ai.featuresLead: Enable or disable each AI capability without changing engines (dictation, LLM, semantic). The quick “AI” panel uses the same toggles.
ai.promptsLead: Instructions sent to the model (English). Visible answers follow your mother language.

threadSummary.label: Thread summary
threadSummary.description: “Summarize” button and panel: LLM summary of the open thread (streaming).

threadTranslate.label: Thread translation
threadTranslate.description: Translates the whole thread to mother language (Settings → General).

messageTranslate.label: Per-message translation
messageTranslate.description: Translation under messages in a different language than yours.

inboxDigest.label: Inbox action brief
inboxDigest.description: AI brief for the folder: decisions, actions, risks.

orgProposals.label: Organize (AI proposals)
orgProposals.description: LLM-suggested groupings in the organization center.

threadQa.label: Thread Q&A
threadQa.description: Natural-language questions about the thread content.

autoThreadSummary.label: Auto summary on open
autoThreadSummary.description: Automatic summary when the thread has enough messages.

composeRewrite.label: AI rewrite
composeRewrite.description: Rewrites selection or draft in the chosen tone.

composeGrammar.label: Grammar check
composeGrammar.description: Fixes spelling and grammar in the draft.

searchNl.label: Natural-language search
searchNl.description: Parses a query into filters and tags.

contactProfile.label: AI contact profile
contactProfile.description: Summary and topics from local mail for a contact.

onboarding.welcomeLead: A few quick choices, then a short guide. Full control stays in Settings.
onboarding.featuresLead: Tick what you want to try. Small models (search, dictation) download in the background.
onboarding.dictationSub: Local Whisper — hold F9 in the composer (change in Settings → AI).
onboarding.semanticSub: Find mail by meaning, not only keywords (MiniLM model).
onboarding.localLlmSub: Optional. The large GGUF is configured later in Settings → AI.
onboarding.llamaMissing: llama-server not found. You can install it via winget below.
onboarding.guideAccounts: Add a mail account: Settings → Accounts (IMAP / password or app password).
onboarding.guideModels: Lightweight models download automatically on first use (status bar).
onboarding.guideDictation: Dictation: open a message, hold F9, speak, release.
onboarding.guideLocalLlm: Local LLM: Settings → AI → download the GGUF when ready (~2 GB).
onboarding.guideSettings: OpenRouter keys, organization, archive: all in Settings when you need them.

toast.openThreadForAgent: Open a thread for the reply assistant.
toast.selectAccountForAgent: Select an account for the reply assistant.
toast.agentAutoMail: Assistant unavailable for automated / newsletter messages.
toast.enableAgentInSettings: Enable “Prepare reply” assistant in AI settings.
toast.runTauri: Available in the Tauri desktop app.
